Datum B = rear slot centre line. 12 pads 1.40 long (12-1.40) from datum B rearward (centre 0.70 behind B). x: A1/B12, A12/B1 at +-3.50 (7.00) and A4/B9, A9/B4 at +-2.50 (2-1.00), 0.80 wide (4-0.80); 8 pads 0.30 wide (8-0.30) at pitch 0.50 (7-0.50), +-0.25..+-1.75, order B8, A5, B7, A6, A7, B6, A8, B5 (p.1 tail labels). Pegs 2X dia 0.60, at x +-3.50 (1.15 inside the rear slots), 0.47 ahead of B: drawn without copper, taken as NPTH. Rear shell slots x +-4.65 (9.30): slot 0.60 x 1.20, copper 0.90 x 1.30. Front shell slots x +-5.92 (11.84), 4.32 ahead of B: slot 0.60 x 1.50, copper 0.90 x 1.60 (4-0.60 / 4-0.90). BOARD CUT-OUT (not in this footprint): 9.14 wide, from about 0.9 ahead of B to the PCB edge. Product edge 5.85 ahead of the front slots. Body 9.58 x 11.07 (p.1 top view), front face at the product edge (10.17 ahead of B). The 2-0.55 dimension on the right side could not be tied to a feature and is not used.

footprints.description: Amphenol 12401951 USB-C receptacle, vertical SMT L=12mm, 24 SMD pads + 6 slotted shell / mid-plate legs
footprints.note: 12401951.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB layout (top view, oriented like the p.1 mating-face view: row A at top with A1 left, B12 below A1), tolerance +-0.05. Pads 24X 0.25 wide, 12X from 1.60 to 3.00 off the centre line (length 1.40, centre 2.30), pitch 0.50 (0.50X11=5.50), both rows centred and aligned. Corner shell slots at x +-4.10 (8.20), y +-3.07 (2X 6.14): horizontal slot 1.30 x 0.80, copper 1.70 x 1.20. Mid-plate slots at x +-3.775 (7.55), y 0: slot 0.95 x 0.55, copper 1.35 x 0.95. Body 9.15 x 6.54 (keep-out p.2, face view p.1).

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402012 USB-C 2.0 receptacle, top mount SMT CH=1.68, 12 SMD pads + 4 slotted shell legs + 2 NPTH pegs
footprints.note: 12402012-10.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB layout (top view; drawn mating face down at product edge, rotated 180 deg here), tolerance +-0.05. Datum = front slot centre line. Product (front) edge 2.60 ahead of datum. Body 8.94 x 7.35 (p.1 top view), front face at the product edge.

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402032 USB-C receptacle, vertical double-row SMT L=6.50mm, 24 SMD pads + 4 slotted shell legs + 2 NPTH pegs
footprints.note: 12402032.pdf p.2 Recommended P.C.B. layout (T 1.00 mm; taken as top view, A1 top-left like the p.1 mating-face view), tolerance +-0.127 unless stated. Shell slots at 1.35 and 6.15 (2X), y +-2.15: horizontal slot 1.00 x 0.60, copper 1.40 x 1.00. Body 8.94 x 3.16 (p.1 housing; the 11.00 x 7.00 outline is the pick-up cap).

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402054 USB-C 2.0 receptacle, right-angle double-DIP standing on edge, 14 plated holes + 4 slotted shell legs
footprints.note: 12402054.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB layout (top view; drawn mating face down toward the PCB edge, rotated 180 deg here), tolerance +-0.05. 14X hole dia 0.40, pad dia 0.60, two columns 0.78 apart, each 1.04 in from the shell slot columns (slots 2.86 apart). Column A (A1, A4, A5, A6, A7, A9, A12) pitch 0.90, A1 to A12 5.40; column B (B12, B9, B7, B6, B5, B4, B1) pitch 0.90, offset 0.45 toward the mating face (B12 0.45 ahead of A1, B1 to B12 5.40). Shell slots 4X: slot 0.60 x 1.60, copper 1.90 long (copper width 0.90 = 0.60 + 2 x 0.15 ring from the length dims); front pair in line with A1, rear pair 4.80 behind (2X4.80). PCB edge 5.05 ahead of A1; connector (front) edge 7.60 ahead of B12. Body 3.16 x 14.55 (p.1 top view 3.16 thick, 14.55 long), front face at the connector edge.

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402056 USB4 Type-C receptacle, top mount CH=1.57, 24 SMD pads + 6 slotted shell legs + 2 NPTH pegs
footprints.note: c12402056.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB layout (top view, board edge down; rotated 180 deg here), tolerance +-0.05. Datum = peg line: 2X dia 0.67 at +-3.60 (7.20), plain circles, taken as NPTH. Pads 12X 0.27 wide, pitch 0.50: row A A1 0.975 from the left peg (x -2.625) to A12 +2.875, 0.90 long from 2.25 to 3.15 behind datum; row B B12 -2.875 to B1 +2.625 (0.25 offset), 0.80 long from 0.70 to 1.50 behind datum (same signal lands as 12402143). Rear shell slots x +-4.32 (8.64), 2.00 behind datum: slot 0.70 x 1.90, copper 1.10 x 2.30. Front slots 3.05 ahead of datum: inner pair x +-4.32 slot 0.70 x 2.00 copper 1.30 x 2.60; outer pair x +-6.42 (12.84) slot 0.85 x 1.80 copper 1.45 x 2.40. A cross-hatched area 7.80 min wide from the peg line to the board edge (4.85 ahead of datum) is not explained on the drawing; the p.1 title says top mount and the mounting-condition view shows the connector on top of the board overhanging its edge by 1.30, so it is read as a keep-out, not a cut-out. Body 8.94 x 9.17 (p.1 top view); front face 6.20 ahead of the peg line (p.1 bottom view).

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402072 USB4 Type-C receptacle, sink mount CH=-0.10, 24 SMD pads + 8 slotted shell legs + 2 NPTH (needs board cut-out)
footprints.note: c12402072.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB layout (top view, PCB edge down; rotated 180 deg here), tolerance +-0.05. Datums: X/Y = centre of the round NPTH dia 0.85; second NPTH oval 1.15 x 0.85 (horizontal) at X+8.50. Connector centre line X+4.25 (1.625 + 2.625; cut-out 2x4.70 about it). Pads 24X 0.27 wide, pitch 0.50: row A A1 X+1.625 .. A12 X+7.125, 0.90 long from 1.70 to 0.80 behind Y; row B B12 X+1.375 .. B1 X+6.875 (0.25 offset), 0.80 long from 0.05 behind to 0.75 ahead of Y. Shell slots (all 0.75 wide, copper (1.35) wide): rear pair horizontal at X-0.15 and X+8.65, 1.625 behind Y, slot 1.50 copper (2.10); side columns at X-2.00 and X+10.50: middle pair 0.10 ahead of Y slot 1.50 copper (2.10), then pairs at 3.15 and 5.85 ahead of Y slot 1.70 copper (2.30). BOARD CUT-OUT (not in this footprint): 9.40 wide (2x4.70) about the centre line, starting about 1.0 ahead of Y with R0.50 notches, open to the PCB edge 7.50 ahead of Y; slot copper outlines carry R0.375/R0.675 keep-outs. Body 8.94 x 10.35 (p.1); front face 1.10 beyond the PCB edge (mounting condition), so 8.60 ahead of Y, rear 1.75 behind.

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402136 USB-C receptacle, mid mount CH=0.40 IP68, 24 SMD pads + 4 slotted shell legs + 2 plated slotted pegs (needs board cut-out)

Rear shell slots 10.05 apart, 0.40 ahead of datum: slot 0.60 x 1.30, copper 1.00 x 1.70. Front shell slots 11.30 apart, 2.60 ahead: slot 0.60 x 1.70, copper 1.20 x 2.30. Body 9.74 x 8.14 (p.1 top view: 6.84 housing + 1.30 tongue past the gasket; rear face about 0.28 behind datum, scaled from the p.1 bottom view).

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402073 USB4 Type-C receptacle, 24 SMD pads + 6 slotted shell legs + 2 NPTH pegs

Pads 12x0.27 wide; A row (A1-A12) 0.90 long, outer edge 3.15 behind datum (centre 2.70); B row (B1-B12) 0.80 long, outer edge 1.50 behind datum (centre 1.10). footprints.description: Amphenol 12402075 USB4 Type-C mid-mount receptacle, 24 SMD pads + 8 slotted shell legs
